resale_co.name: Construction Records Clearance Certificate (CRC)
resale_co.issued_by: Alexandria Township Building Department (Construction Code Enforcement)
resale_co.lead_time: The Township page says to submit the CRC application at least 30 business days before closing; the ordinance requires the application and fee at least 10 business days before the change of ownership
requirements: Records inspection by the construction office: all permits on the block and lot must be inspected and closed by the subcode officials
If there are open permits, all final inspections and prior approvals must be obtained before the CRC is issued
Smoke detector certification is required before closing and a copy must be forwarded to the Building Department
Application lists seller, real estate agent, seller's attorney, block and lot and approximate year built

fees.label: Construction Records Clearance application
fees.quote: The cost of the application is $50.00 payable to Alexandria Township.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Get the CRC application from the Building Department (242 Little York-Mt. Pleasant Road, Milford) or download it from the Township site, and submit it with the $50.00 fee payable to Alexandria Township. The seller or the seller's agent files it.
resale_co.contact_title: Technical Assistant to the Construction Official

evidence.quote: This certificate is required on the sale of all residential and commercial properties.
The purpose of the CRC is to ensure that all permits obtained through the building department for a particular Block and Lot have been inspected and closed by the appropriate Sub-code (inspector).
The application for a CRC should be submitted at least 30 business days prior to the closing date.
An application for a CRC can be obtained through the Building Department located at 242 Little York-Mt. Pleasant Road, Milford, NJ or by calling Marianna Voorhees at (908) 996-7071 ext. 211.
A CRC shall be required prior to the sale of any residential or commercial structure and prior to the rental of any tenant space in a commercial structure within the Township.
The applicant shall submit with the application fees for the CRC as follows to cover the administrative cost: $50.
Failure to obtain a Construction Records Clearance Certificate prior to closing may result in a penalty of $1,000.00.
SMOKE DETECTOR CERTIFICATION IS REQUIRED PRIOR TO CLOSING AND A COPY IS TO BE FORWARDED TO OUR OFFICE.

resale_co.notes: Alexandria does not do a physical resale inspection; the CRC is a records check of open construction permits (Code 64-6, added 4-8-2009). Exemptions in the ordinance include deed corrections, transfers between spouses, transfers by an estate executor, refinancing and transfers to a bankruptcy trustee, as long as there is no change in physical occupancy. Lead time conflict: the Township page says 30 business days, the ordinance and form say 10 business days; plan on 30. Contact emails come from the Building Department page (Construction Official Mark Farneski: constructionofficial@alexandrianj.gov; technical assistant: construction@alexandrianj.gov). A 2016 copy of the information sheet still named Ginny Colucci; the current web page names Marianna Voorhees.

requirements: Smoke alarm on each level of the home and outside each separate sleeping area
Battery-only smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed battery units; hardwired alarms from original construction may not be replaced with battery alarms
Carbon monoxide alarm in the immediate vicinity of the sleeping areas (where there is a fuel-burning appliance or attached garage)

authorities.name: Alexandria Township Bureau of Fire Prevention (Fire Marshal)
authorities.lead_time: Call the Fire Marshal to schedule; no lead time published
authorities.how_to_apply: Call Fire Marshal Mike Giannone at 908-612-3592 to arrange the smoke detector inspection, then forward a copy of the certificate to the Building Department before closing.

evidence.quote: Fire Marshall Mike Giannone (908) 612-3592 Call to arrange smoke detector inspections
A Smoke Detector Certification is also required prior to selling your home.
The local enforcing agency shall be the Bureau of Fire Prevention, which is hereby created and established by this chapter.
Smoke detector and carbon monoxide alarm compliance inspection fees shall be in accordance with N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d).
Alexandria Township1001 LEAID: 1001-001 Enf Auth. Municipal Fire Official Michael G Giannone Phone (908) 996-7071 Email mggiannone@att.net

fire_cert.notes: Alexandria locally enforces the Uniform Fire Code through its Bureau of Fire Prevention (Chapter 24, rewritten 11-13-2025 by Ord. No. 2025-006). The ordinance does not list its own smoke/CO certificate fees; it says they follow the state schedule in N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d), and the Township does not post the dollar amounts, so no fee is recorded here. The state fire directory lists the Fire Official at the Township office line (908) 996-7071 and email mggiannone@att.net; the Township page gives 908-612-3592 for scheduling. The fire extinguisher requirement was dropped from the state sale certificate by P.L.2025, c.19; no Township page says whether it is still checked.

open_questions: What is the current smoke/CO certificate fee (the ordinance points to the state schedule in N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.9(d) but no amount is posted)?
How far ahead should the CRC be filed: 30 business days (web page) or 10 business days (ordinance and form)?
Does the Fire Marshal still check for a portable fire extinguisher after P.L.2025, c.19?
How long is the CRC valid if the closing is delayed?
